TMC ACTREC Plumber cum Pump Operator Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the TMC ACTREC recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Plumber cum Pump Operator. This is a contract-based position announced by TMC ACTREC.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Plumber cum Pump Operator post. This is a single opening announced through this walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Plumber cum Pump Operator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSC with an ITI in Plumbing (1-year course) from a Government-recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required experience for this role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 2-3 years of experience is required in plumbing system operation, pipeline works, toilet maintenance, and operation of STP/WTP/Pumps.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Plumber cum Pump Operator position?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 33 years. However, this limit may be relaxed based on the candidate's experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Plumber cum Pump Operator role?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary offered ranges from ₹26,210/- to ₹35,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attend a walk-in interview. They must report to the specified venue with all required documents on the interview date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the date and time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 28th September 2026, with reporting time between 10:00 a.m. and 10:30 a.m.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The venue is the Ground Floor, Pushp Building, TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai - 410210.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry their Bio-data, photograph, Aadhar Card, PAN CARD, and original and self-attested copies of qualification and experience certificates.
